correctness.rationale: The flats of the uniform matroid are precisely subsets of size at most r-1 plus the full ground set. The proof derives the entire three-round game from four-cell membership counts, an exact 81-state third-extension test, and explicit pumping transformations reducing arbitrary ground size, rank slack, and flat size to eleven canonical pointed cases. Four rank-three existence sentences separate the five classes. Independent direct and orbit-based finite calculations agree (15 directly enumerated lattices, 5 orbit classes through n=16, and over 60,000 boundary checks). All-parameter pumping follows from the exact cell-state analysis, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: This gives a complete classification across an elementary but central family of geometric lattices with two independent unbounded matroid parameters, sharply shows ground-set size disappears in pure rank-three logic, and determines the smallest universal representative (121 flats). Rank-truncation fundamentally changes both lattice structure and logical data relative to a full Boolean lattice. A complete, naturally parameterized classification with sharp logical separating witnesses has independent mathematical utility without needing a downstream theorem.
